I don't know of a LlamaIndex class called `GraphRAGCommunityRetriever`, and I have no project context that mentions it, so I can't say what it extends.

The closest classes I know of come from LlamaIndex's GraphRAG community-summary examples (the cookbook and the v2 variant):

- `GraphRAGStore`, which extends a property graph store (`SimplePropertyGraphStore` or `Neo4jPropertyGraphStore`, depending on the example). It builds communities and summaries.
- `GraphRAGQueryEngine`, which extends `CustomQueryEngine`. It answers queries from the community summaries.
